title: Approximating Optimal Welfare in Complementary Allocation under Decentralized Information
abstract: arXiv:2609.14301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complementary resources are often allocated by agencies that see different coordinates of an individual's needs. If an intervention requires complementary resources, an agency may know if said person lacks its own resource; yet not know if supplying completes a useful bundle. We study allocation of $m$ divisible complementary goods when each agency observes only its own coordinate of a baseline-access profile.   To isolate information from incentives, we measure the welfare cost of this split against a generous decentralized benchmark DEC: the best rule that acts on local information alone, with cooperative agencies and known population distribution and capacities. Even so, local observation alone can make optimally coordinated policies arbitrarily inefficient: a factor linear in $m$ (even with equal capacities), and a factor inverse in OPT (with but three agencies). translated_title: 分散信息下互补资源配置的最优福利近似
translated_abstract: 互补资源通常由各自只能看到个体需求某一维度的机构来分配。如果一项干预需要互补资源，某个机构可能知道该个体是否缺乏其负责的资源，但不知道提供该资源能否凑齐一个有用的组合。我们研究了 $m$ 种可分割互补商品的分配问题，其中每个机构只能观察到基准可及性画像中属于自己的一维信息。为了将信息因素与激励因素分离，我们以一个宽裕的分散化基准 DEC 来衡量这种信息分割造成的福利成本：DEC 是仅基于局部信息行动的最佳规则，且假设机构是合作的、人群分布和容量均为已知。即便在如此宽松的条件下，仅凭局部观察也可能使最优协调策略任意低效：损失因子随 $m$ 线性增长（即使各机构容量相等），或与最优福利 OPT 成反比（仅需三个机构即可出现）。阈值转介机制能够挽回大部分此类损失：当某机构……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究了各机构仅能观察到个体需求自身维度的分散信息下互补商品分配问题，证明了仅凭局部信息的最优协调策略可能任意低效（损失随商品数线性增长或与最优福利成反比），并提出阈值转介机制可挽回大部分损失。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the allocation of divisible complementary goods when each agency observes only its own coordinate of an individual's needs, proving that locally-informed optimal coordination can be arbitrarily inefficient (loss linear in the number of goods or inverse in OPT), and showing that threshold referral mechanisms recover most of this loss.
